title: Rwanda at a glance
supports: Red Rocks Rwanda as a cultural centre in a valley near Volcanoes National Park and its visitor-oriented community setting
hidden_gem_rationale: A community-run cultural stop near Musanze that offers direct local exchange beyond the region's famous gorilla-trekking circuit.

title: Rwanda at a glance
supports: Buhanga Eco-Park as a 31-hectare sacred forest associated with historic royal enthronement and initiation rituals
hidden_gem_rationale: A small culturally significant forest overshadowed by nearby Volcanoes National Park and absent from Rwanda's established headline set.

title: Rwanda at a glance
supports: Roots of Nyabingi community experiences in northern Rwanda including local food, dance, history, birdwatching, hikes and boat tours
hidden_gem_rationale: A rural community experience with flexible locally hosted activities, distinct from Rwanda's flagship national parks and memorials.

publisher: Tunisian National Tourist Office / Discover Tunisia
title: From Dougga to Sbeïtla
supports: Bulla Regia's Roman houses with underground rooms designed as shelter from the heat
hidden_gem_rationale: An unusually intimate Roman domestic site that receives far less attention than Carthage, Dougga and El Jem in Tunisia's headline heritage circuit.

publisher: Tunisian National Tourist Office / Discover Tunisia
title: From Dougga to Sbeïtla
supports: Makthar archaeological site, its triumphal arch and its pre-Roman dolmens
hidden_gem_rationale: An inland site where Numidian and Roman layers can be read together, outside Tunisia's established coastal and Carthage highlights.

title: Mlawula Nature Reserve
supports: Mlawula's savannah, woodland and Lubombo habitats, high bird and plant diversity, and its rougher, more challenging visitor character
hidden_gem_rationale: A rugged, low-facility reserve explicitly presented as wilder than neighbouring Hlane, offering biodiversity without flagship-park crowds.

title: Mantenga Lifestyle & Craft Centre
supports: owner-run craft businesses at the centre, including Swati beadwork, textiles, jewellery and woodcarving, and its community-development origins
hidden_gem_rationale: A maker-focused cluster of independent Swati businesses beneath the better-known Mantenga attractions, with direct links to local artisans.

title: Aride Island
supports: warden-led nature walks across Aride's plantation and coastal forest, rare plants, guide requirement and difficult southeast-monsoon landings
hidden_gem_rationale: A tightly managed conservation island reached by weather-dependent boat landing, well beyond Seychelles' familiar resort beaches.

title: Fond Ferdinand
supports: Fond Ferdinand's coco de mer sanctuary on southwestern Praslin and its hiking and walking activities
hidden_gem_rationale: A quieter coco de mer forest alternative to nearby Vallée de Mai, with substantial conservation value and fewer headline associations.

title: Lesotho Travel & Investor Guide
supports: Kome Cave Dwelling in Pulane, its living descendants, San paintings and guided cave-dwelling tours with cultural activities
hidden_gem_rationale: A living rural heritage site where residents and landscape carry the history, distinct from Lesotho's famous passes, dams and waterfalls.

place: Liphofung Cave and Cultural Heritage Site
title: Liphofung Cave and Cultural Heritage Site
supports: Liphofung's cultural, historical and archaeological heritage dating to the Late Stone Age and its role as an interpreted tourism site
hidden_gem_rationale: A small northern heritage landscape with deep archaeological evidence, omitted from Lesotho's established mountain-adventure highlights.

title: The Park
supports: guided small-group approaches to free-ranging habituated mandrills, physical demands, reservation requirement and park location near Bakoumba
hidden_gem_rationale: A conservation-led primate experience in southeastern Gabon, far from the country's better-known coastal and Loango wildlife circuit.

publisher: Congo Basin Forest Partnership with Gabon ANPN and Ministry of Water and Forests
title: Detailed Information Note on Field Trips
supports: Raponda Walker Arboretum's protected biodiversity, 15-metre canopy tower and Discovery of the Forest trail near Libreville
hidden_gem_rationale: A forest-education trail on the capital's edge that reveals Gabonese tree diversity without presenting a flagship national-park safari.

title: The Royal Mausoleums of Ancient Algeria
supports: Imedghassen at Boumia in Batna, its fourth-century BCE date and its role in Algeria's Numidian monumental funerary tradition
hidden_gem_rationale: An early Numidian monument in the northern interior that is far less familiar than Algeria's inscribed Roman cities and Saharan icons.

title: The Royal Mausoleums of Ancient Algeria
supports: the Djeddars near Frenda in Tiaret and their fifth- to sixth-century funerary date
hidden_gem_rationale: A remote late-antique mausoleum group on Algeria's tentative list, outside the country's well-known Roman and desert itineraries.

publisher: Instituto do Património Cultural de Cabo Verde
title: Traditional Pottery
supports: Rabil on Boa Vista as one of Cabo Verde's centres of traditional hand-built pottery
hidden_gem_rationale: A living craft practice in an inland village, offering a local encounter beyond Boa Vista's resort beaches and turtle excursions.

title: Carry the 10 Cabo Verde Islands in your pocket! - Part 1
supports: Juncalinho's natural pools on São Nicolau as clear pools set into a quiet rocky Atlantic coast
hidden_gem_rationale: A small swimming place on an underrated island, specifically promoted for tranquillity rather than Cabo Verde's established resort scene.

publisher: Ministry of Tourism and Leisure, Côte d'Ivoire
title: Sublime Côte d’Ivoire
supports: walking or cycling in Banco National Park as part of an Abidjan weekend itinerary
hidden_gem_rationale: An urban rainforest outing that sits outside Abidjan's familiar skyline, market and nightlife highlights.

publisher: Ministry of Tourism and Leisure, Côte d'Ivoire
title: Sublime Côte d’Ivoire
supports: a walk at Bingerville Botanical Garden as part of an Abidjan weekend itinerary
hidden_gem_rationale: A low-key garden excursion in historic Bingerville that broadens the capital-region offer beyond its established urban landmarks.

title: The Dassa Hills
supports: guided or independent walking among Dassa's granite formations, caves, viewpoints and spiritually important sites
hidden_gem_rationale: A locally meaningful inland walking landscape beyond Benin's famous Ouidah, Ganvié and Pendjari circuit.

place: Bouche du Roy guided canoe trip
title: La Bouche du Roy
supports: local-guide canoe or boat visits where the Mono River meets the Atlantic among mangroves, dunes and wetlands
hidden_gem_rationale: A guide-led estuary journey in the far southwest, distinct from Benin's iconic lake village and memorial-route attractions.

title: Museu da Moeda
supports: the museum's story of Angolan exchange from nzimbu shells to the kwanza, numismatic collections and audiovisual interpretation
hidden_gem_rationale: A specialist museum that tells national history through everyday exchange, overshadowed by Luanda's fortress and military collections.

title: Parque Nacional da Quissama
supports: Quiçama's location south of Luanda, its mangrove, forest and savannah habitats, varied fauna and visitor facilities near the Kwanza River
hidden_gem_rationale: A large protected landscape accessible from Luanda but less internationally recognised than Angola's desert and waterfall icons.

title: Cultural and gastronomic activities
supports: the Coffee Museum at Roça Monte Café and its interpretation of coffee from planting and harvest through drying to the finished product
hidden_gem_rationale: A crop-specific community museum that adds depth beyond generic plantation tours and the islands' better-known volcanic scenery.

publisher: Ministry of Environment, Climate Change & Natural Resources, The Gambia
title: Information on the protected areas in The Gambia
supports: Abuko's gallery forest, pools, bird walk, education centre, photo hides and more than 270 recorded bird species
hidden_gem_rationale: A compact reserve near Banjul with rare gallery forest and purpose-built birdwatching spots, distinct from the better-known river and coastal reserves.

place: Moucha and Maskali islands reef trip
publisher: Agence Nationale du Tourisme de Djibouti
title: Key sites of Djibouti
supports: Moucha and Maskali as coral islands near Djibouti City with mangroves, beaches, reefs and notable underwater life
hidden_gem_rationale: A small near-capital island reef excursion outside Djibouti's established Lake Assal, Lake Abbé and whale-shark highlights.

publisher: Presidency of the Republic of the Congo
title: Monuments
supports: the Musée du Cercle africain as a regional museum in Pointe-Noire with African art and photography collections
hidden_gem_rationale: A compact regional collection in Pointe-Noire, far less prominent than Congo's Odzala wildlife experiences and Brazzaville riverfront.
